procedures.name: Colonoscopy
procedures.description: A screening procedure to examine the large intestine for polyps or cancer. Recommended for adults 45 and older.
procedures.coverage: Preventive care - covered with no copay

procedures.name: Mammography
procedures.description: Breast imaging procedure used to detect breast cancer. Recommended annually for women 40 and older.
procedures.coverage: Preventive care - covered with no copay

procedures.name: Blood Pressure Check
procedures.description: Basic screening to measure blood pressure and detect hypertension. Covered as preventive care.
procedures.coverage: Preventive care - covered with no copay

procedures.name: Cholesterol Screening
procedures.description: Blood test to measure cholesterol levels. Recommended for early detection of heart disease risk.
procedures.coverage: Preventive care - covered with no copay

procedures.name: Influenza Vaccination
procedures.description: Annual flu shot to prevent influenza infection. Recommended for all individuals 6 months and older.
procedures.coverage: Preventive care - covered with no copay

procedures.name: MRI Scan
procedures.description: Imaging procedure using magnetic fields to create detailed images of soft tissues.
procedures.coverage: Requires deductible and coinsurance; may need prior authorization

procedures.name: CT Scan
procedures.description: Computed tomography scan using X-rays to create cross-sectional images.
procedures.coverage: Requires deductible and coinsurance; may need prior authorization

procedures.name: Physical Therapy
procedures.description: Treatment to restore function and reduce pain after injury or surgery.
procedures.coverage: Typically requires referral and has session limits

procedures.name: Joint Replacement Surgery
procedures.description: Surgical procedure to replace damaged joints, commonly done for knee or hip arthritis.
procedures.coverage: Requires hospitalization costs and surgical facility fees

procedures.name: Cardiac Stress Test
procedures.description: Test to evaluate heart function during exercise. Used to diagnose heart conditions.
procedures.coverage: Requires deductible and coinsurance; may need prior authorization
